images.alt: Aerial view of burned vehicles and damaged property in the Palestinian town of Huwara after a settler rampage, February 2023
images.caption: An aerial view of torched cars and homes in the Palestinian town of Huwara near Nablus after a settler pogrom, February 26, 2023.

images.alt: Palestinian farmers with sheep grazing in the West Bank near Deir Jarir
images.caption: Palestinian shepherds graze their flock in the occupied West Bank near the village of Deir Jarir. Settlers have killed or stolen over 8,000 sheep and goats in 2026 alone.

images.alt: Palestinian woman standing near olive trees damaged by settlers in Qusra
images.caption: A Palestinian woman gestures next to olive trees damaged by Israeli settlers in the village of Qusra, northern West Bank. Over 27,000 olive trees have been destroyed since 2023.

images.alt: Palestinian woman amid ruins of demolished home in Masafer Yatta
images.caption: A Palestinian woman stands amid the ruins of her demolished home in Masafer Yatta, occupied West Bank. Over 100 villages have been emptied since 2023.
